title: Mandatory provenance data for AI-generated media

research.what: An industry coalition created a cryptographically signed metadata standard that records where digital content came from and how it was edited, so AI-generated media can be identified. Origin: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) content credentials specification, coalition formed 2021 (founding year from general knowledge; the sources retrieved name C2PA but do not give the year)

change.what: From 1 October 2026, Connecticut's CART Act requires generative AI providers with more than one million monthly users to embed tamper-resistant provenance data in AI-generated audio, image and video, where commercially and technically reasonable. Sources point to C2PA as the reference approach.

note: Takes AI content provenance from a voluntary industry standard to a binding state requirement in the US. California's AI Transparency Act, operative 2 August 2026, came first, so the milestone year is 2026 either way.
company: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA)

title: Zero-knowledge age proofs in EU age verification app

research.what: Anonymous credential schemes built on zero-knowledge proofs let a user prove a single attribute, such as being over 18, without revealing any other identity data. Origin: Anonymous credential schemes of Brands (2000) and Camenisch & Lysyanskaya (2001), building on zero-knowledge proofs; cited as foundations of age-assurance cryptography

change.what: The European Commission's age verification 'mini wallet' now sets zero-knowledge proofs as the required way to present proof of age. National pilots are live, with Denmark launching in June 2026, and member states have been asked to make it available by the end of 2026.

note: This is the first government-backed rollout of zero-knowledge anonymous credentials for online age checks across several countries. It shows privacy-preserving cryptography moving from research into national-scale use.

title: Commercial LEO navigation (Xona Pulsar)

research.what: Xona's Huginn demonstrator, launched in May 2022, was the first commercially funded low-Earth-orbit navigation mission. It went on to show centimetre-level positioning using Xona's patented distributed atomic-clock architecture. Origin: Xona Space Systems Huginn LEO PNT demonstration satellite, SpaceX Transporter-5, May 2022 (team from Stanford GPS Research Lab)

change.what: Six production Pulsar navigation satellites launched on SpaceX Bandwagon-5 on 20 October 2026, and full commercial positioning, navigation and timing service is due to start in 2027.

note: This is the first privately run satellite navigation constellation, broadcasting from low orbit in the GPS band with authenticated signals that resist jamming. The FCC has authorised the full constellation of more than 250 satellites.
